Using only the two known public schema paths and the exact full_relation.encode format (sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False, final LF), each 34-byte encoding hashes to the corresponding actual VALUE witness location. No private value or private path was guessed or reconstructed.

At full_relation.py line273, projected.result.stdout_sha256 and stderr_sha256 are assigned SHA256 of the normalized stdout/stderr byte values. Lines 276-277 include those same byte values separately as whole.stdout and whole.stderr.

A difference in the resulting hash string entails a difference in its underlying normalized bytes: identical bytes deterministically produce the same hash. Thus the two observed result-hash VALUE differences force a further difference at each of the two normalized stream byte fields.

compare at lines163-193 recursively counts every difference. Only the retained witness list is limited to two; the difference_count is not truncated at two. Each unequal bytes field contributes one comparison difference regardless of how many bytes differ.

Two result-hash differences plus two normalized-stream differences account for the actual complete count of four. Therefore there is no additional difference detected elsewhere in this whole projection under the unchanged comparator.

diagnostic_proposal_advice.assessment: A finite diagnostic vocabulary in the existing refusal channel is a proportionate minimal observation improvement for the demonstrated opacity. It can prevent another refusal from losing its recognized classification; it cannot prevent every one-shot failure or establish the old cause.
diagnostic_proposal_advice.rationale: The baseline recipient catch discards the recognized failure predicate after allocating the private directory. The existing precore_exception already uses exact ValueError type, a single exact string argument and a closed literal allowlist. Reusing that pattern avoids an independent telemetry framework or export of arbitrary diagnostics.
boundaries: Admit only exact reviewed finite literals from the relevant setup/currentness/capture paths; unknown exceptions, subclasses and arbitrary arguments remain generic.
Do not call str/repr on arbitrary exceptions or export exception chains, response bodies, URLs, headers, tokens, paths, stdout/stderr, or caller-supplied text.

Translate recognized provider HTTP 401/403/404/429 into fixed constants without their response data; all other statuses/errors stay within a fixed generic vocabulary. A code records the observed refusal class, not a stronger assertion about its cause.
Keep the existing public_result fields, REFUSED disposition, authority NONE, cleanup behavior and original_awards empty. A more specific code must not become success or grant evidence.

Propagate the closed code vocabulary through carrier_policy, external entry public_result validation, author/precore_projection carrier_refusal and all existing generated/export/receiving users. Otherwise a newly emitted code can be replaced by a secondary validation refusal.
